name: Auto Complete
description: Noclip-based auto complete with a pause-menu toggle and built-in safe mode.

enabled.name: Auto Complete
enabled.description: When ON, the player cannot die, so every level (main or online) reaches 100%. Can also be toggled from the pause menu.

pause-button.name: Show Pause Menu Toggle
pause-button.description: Show an ON/OFF checkbox in the pause menu.
